verdict.rationale: Claude Code's entire premise is delegating tasks to a built-in AI agent: docs describe it planning approaches, writing code across files, running tests, handling git workflows, and autonomously completing multi-step tasks (docs-2, docs-3, docs-20, docs-28, gh-3). This is corroborated by extensive first-party documentation and some community confirmation that it performs well as a coding assistant, though other community reports describe reliability issues and failure modes in autonomous execution. Missing for 10: independent benchmark-level validation of consistent task delegation success and stronger consensus on reliability (community reports show notable failure cases).
